title: Add intake contract validator and release change-summary bundler
author: Priya Nair
description: Context and motivation: onboarding inconsistencies and manual changelog drafting are a recurring engineering cost. This PR introduces two complementary components: 1) an intake contract validator that enforces a minimal metadata/contract surface for every model upload (schema, required affinity hints, resource constraints, privacy tags), and 2) a change-summary bundler that generates a concise release note draft by diffing model metadata, profile deltas, and sample performance signatures. Design highlights: the contract validator is implemented as a lightweight, pluggable step in the intake pipeline (src/intake/contract_validator.py). It translates contract rules to a small rule engine (YAML-driven) so that product can extend rules without code changes. Validator returns structured diagnostics and suggested auto-fixes where safe (e.g., infer missing license from metadata or normalize alias formats). The change-summary bundler (src/onboard/change_summary_bundler.py) computes semantic deltas across three axes: metadata fields, serialized performance profiles, and a compact coverage fingerprint. It uses configurable heuristics for importance weighting (profile regressions, breaking API changes, variant removals) to surface a 3-sentence human-friendly summary and a set of suggested bullet points for the release notes. Compatibility and gating: the validator is a non-blocking soft-gate by default for existing customers (warn-only) and can be toggled to fail intake for new enforcement windows. This PR wires an initial enforcement policy and adds an ops flag to roll over enforcement per workspace. Testing and CI: added unit and integration tests that simulate sample onboard flows and edge-case profiles. CI caught a typing issue in the bundler on first run; fixed in subsequent commit. Rollout plan: merged to main as feature-flagged components. Step 1: enable warning-only mode globally for two weeks to surface common issues. Step 2: capture top offending workspaces and propose remediation. Step 3: flip to fail-only enforcement for new uploads in a controlled cadence. Follow-ups: add UI annotations in console to surface validation issues, build a linear automation to auto-schedule remediation tickets, and land a small performance optimization for large profile diffs. Related work: touches intake pipeline (ENG-1182) and release automation spike (ENG-1187).

release_notes: Introduce an intake contract validator to enforce minimal model metadata and provide actionable diagnostics (warning-mode by default).
Add a change-summary bundler that autogenerates a concise release note draft by diffing metadata and performance profiles — reduces manual release note drafting.
Ops: feature is behind a workspace-level flag; rollout plan and runbook included in docs.
impact_summary: Operational: should reduce onboarding friction and surface incompatible or missing metadata early. Developer-facing: automates first-pass release notes and highlights high-risk profile regressions. No breaking changes enabled by default.
